visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable frames including the compact preview. Individual Sheikh Lotfollah exterior: broad warm pointed dome, blue cylindrical drum, small bead finial, blue rectangular entrance with nested pointed recess, shallow wooden door and original broad triangular vault cells, low brick body and pale base. Removed floating-looking dome accents. Stopped roof and base bands around the whole portal; clipped overlapping drum masonry/bands out of the recess and omitted drum fields inside it. The portal emits the reveal once, eliminating overlapping surfaces visible as stripes in the skyline. Current entrance is clear. Detailed internal plans, roof divisions, side/rear bays and subheights are estimates. Fine tile/calligraphic artwork, exact muqarnas patterns, fixtures and unseen interiors omitted.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final shared/geographic-flat frames including the north-up raw-outline overlay. Five existing shared 256² brick, sandstone, lime plaster, generic mosaic and wood graphs serve seven merged roles including local opaque blue-grey fields. Warm dome and blue drum/portal reuse one mosaic graph with different linear tints. Metric UVs; zero embedded images, copied photographs, baked lighting or unique facade atlases. Every graph is read once; eviction leaves zero live model geometries and restores the host ground. Original anchor and heading remain fixed. Exact six-vertex main outline and 19-vertex rounded roof part retained. Long bazaar building remains host content. Flat terrain verifies transforms and replacement, not precise ground contact.

Inspected the matched skyline at full size; the doubled reveal stripes are corrected. Skyline 311 retains the warm pointed dome, blue drum, rectangular pointed entrance recess and mapped low body; small fields, frame strips and finial beads drop out. District 887 adds sparse fields and main entrance trim. Street 3051 adds recessed bays, drum openings and nested portal details. Closeup 4587 refines apertures and adds broad original vault cells/beads. Initial skyline plus district 119092 bytes plus shared textures at one/seven draws. Some specular/shadow bands remain visible across coarse dome facets; fine mosaic artwork is deliberately abstracted. Synthetic neighborhood and coarse normal-viewer terrain are fixtures; physical phone/laptop timings remain pending.

fidelityReview.notes: Individual medium-fi Sheikh Lotfollah Mosque exterior: warm pointed dome on blue cylindrical drum, small bead finial, recessed blue pointed entrance with broad original faceted vault cells, pale base and low brick body. Exact main outline and mapped rounded roof-part retained; main mapped total 32 m guides top. Five existing shared 256² graphs, seven merged material roles and four budgeted browser LODs. Bazaar, square, exact tile artwork, hidden passage/interiors and precise terrain joins remain outside this asset. Retained map and current PMTiles main-building height are 32 m; retained dome-height statement is also 32 m. Use 32 m as whole-model finial top above the working floor, not as an eaves height. There is no independently mapped roof-part height or datum. Visualization subdivisions: main low roof 11.8 m, front flanks 11.8 m, blue drum 11.8–16.8 m, warm pointed dome 16.8–30.8 m and small bead finial to 32 m; blue entrance frame 16.5 m with pointed recess top 14.7 m. Detailed subheights and roof profiles are estimates. No minarets or open courtyard are added. Fine tile/calligraphic artwork, hidden corridors, muqarnas patterns and furnished interiors are omitted or broadly abstracted. Two actually inspected useful Commons pictures guide the signed portal and warm/blue massing. Main current and retained mapped height is 32 m and the whole finial top uses that above the working floor. Rounded roof part has no independent height. Subheights, portal/recess dimensions, detailed low roofs and secondary bays remain visualization estimates. Fine floral/calligraphic tile art, exact vault patterns, hidden corridors and furnished interiors are not reproduced. Bazaar, square and surrounding city remain host content.
